message.content:
I’m happy to help you compute the slope gradient, but I’ll need the elevation (height above sea level) for each of the two points.  
The slope gradient is defined as the change in elevation divided by the horizontal distance between the points, usually expressed as an angle (degrees), a percent, or a ratio. With only latitude/longitude coordinates you can calculate the horizontal distance, but without the vertical component (elevation) the slope can’t be determined.

Could you provide the elevations for:

1. (40.7128 N, –74.0060 W) – [Elevation in meters or feet]  
2. (34.0522 N, –118.2437 W) – [Elevation in meters or feet]

Once I have those, I can compute the slope gradient in degrees for you.
